name: Director Morag Strachan

intro.text: Regional Director, Scotland. This glen is now a premium walking experience. Your ticket is, let me see, not valid.
I've read the reports. Pryce, Ashcombe, Kerrigan. I don't intend to be the fourth.

win: That was unforeseen. I shall foresee it next time.
after: Loch Ness is next on our list. We've a survey boat. And a very large net.
